Duplicate Properties

How Duplicate Properties Work on PropertyList.es

Listing a Property: Each property entry includes details such as the property’s price, features, photos ect. Find out how to list a property here.

1. Identifying Duplicates: PropertyList uses various algorithms and human overview to identify potential duplicate listings by comparing photos, details and other relevant information to determine if they are duplicates.

2. Selecting the Main Listing: When duplicates are confirmed, the main listing is chosen based on a point system where the one with the best photos, most detailed information, overall completeness, first listing uploaded, if is listed by a Verified Agency and various other ways. This ensures that the most attractive and informative version of the property is displayed to the end user.

3. Reporting Duplicates: Agents can also report listings as duplicates. These reports are reviewed by PropertyList to verify and merge any duplicate entries.

4. MLS Duplicate Section: Other agents within the MLS can see all duplicate listings in a dedicated section of the main listing. This section includes the agency name, price, commission offered and a link to the property.

5. Maintaining Accuracy: PropertyList continuously monitors listings to ensure accuracy and prevent future duplicates. Agents are encouraged to regularly update their listings to keep the information current.

By following these steps, PropertyList maintains a clean and accurate database of properties, making it easier and more enjoyable for users to find the right property.
